label: Брат
description: Twelve-mission case drill for брат (brother) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form брат has a zero ending and names the subject. Here брат is the one who works, so it stands in the nominative as the grammatical subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The nominative брат adds -а to become брата. Possession with у demands the genitive, marking брата as the owner of the car.
Strategic focus: Dative singular. The ending shifts to -у, giving брату. The verb подарить marks the recipient with the dative, so брату receives the gift.

Strategic focus: Accusative singular. The direct object of видеть takes the accusative, but because брат is animate, the accusative copies the genitive: брата. Animacy is why the form ends in -а rather than staying брат.

missions.phrase: Я поехал в отпуск с братом.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The ending becomes -ом, producing братом. The preposition с meaning together with requires the instrumental, naming братом as the travelling companion.
Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. The ending is -е, giving брате. The preposition о meaning about forces the prepositional, the case for the topic of conversation.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. The plural is irregular: the stem expands to брать- and takes -я, giving братья. As the ones who live, they stand in the nominative.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. The irregular soft stem брать- takes -ев, giving братьев. The word нет signalling absence governs the genitive, marking the missing brothers as братьев.
Strategic focus: Dative plural. The expanded stem братья- takes the dative ending -ям, producing братьям. The recipients of the letter stand in the dative.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural. The direct object of любить would be accusative, but animacy makes the accusative plural copy the genitive plural: братьев. The form matches the genitive, not the nominative братья, because the noun is animate.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The expanded stem братья- takes -ями, giving братьями. The verb гордиться governs the instrumental, marking братьями as the source of the pride.

Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. The expanded stem братья- takes the prepositional ending -ях, giving братьях. The preposition о meaning about governs the prepositional, marking братьях as the topic.
